headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and rising — 43.3/100; Bohai Strait is the lead driver, -4% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **43.3/100** (**high**), up 0.8 pts week-over-week. 5 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Bohai Strait**, running **169.0/day** vs a normal of **176.0/day** (-4%).
**359** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Bosporus Strait** is running **51% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$96.02/bbl** (+6.99% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$70.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$157K** cost-of-delay ($78K–$259K).
